entries.note: Single independent audit of the first-pass bytes (target_sha256 re-derived at write time): verdict clean-with-findings (0 blocker, 0 major, 5 minor, 5 nit), no remediation needed. docs/I18N.md step 3 says high-visibility/safety copy needs a SECOND independent audit; the doc does not define whether a keys legend or notification banners are high-visibility.
